Question
========
According to Milanovic, roughly how much of income differences across the world is explained by country of birth and parents' income together?

Answerlist
----------
* About 80%
* About 20%
* About 50%
* Almost nothing; effort explains most of it

Solution
========
Milanovic estimates about 60% for country of birth and about 20% for parents' income position, leaving about 20% for effort, luck, and other factors.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
